parsed.why: State-enforced morality regime: death-penalty clause, morality-police surveillance, documented flogging, detention and sexual assault of trans women; visibly trans people face gravest risk, no protection. Near the absolute extreme.

No same-sex criminalisation; stable rule of law and documented LGB tolerance/protective diplomacy, but no trans-specific acceptance or gender-identity protection; only dated single trans attack. No visitor-facing restriction documented.

Bill passed parliament criminalising identifying as transgender/cross-dressing with prison and reporting duty, plus existing morality law, mob violence and no protections; not yet assented or enforced, so below active-enforcement cases.

Active same-sex statute used against trans people on gender expression; documented arbitrary arrests, police genital humiliation, ID exposure, official hostility and violence; no legal gender recognition, anti-discrimination or working recourse.

Same-sex conduct recently read down, but no gender-identity protections; police dismissive of anti-LGBT violence, documented anti-gay killing and tourist hostility, no trans-specific records. Old harms and unresolved border/facility rules leave elevated risk.
